subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should this PR's forced post-clean-shutdown process.exit(0), strict internal /healthz?strict=1 recovery probe, and OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS env override become the Gateway recovery contract?
rationale: The code path is a plausible and well-tested mitigation, but it intentionally changes process-exit and supervised duplicate-start behavior and adds an operator-facing env surface, so automation should not decide that product and upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept Recovery Contract
options.body: Proceed after Gateway-owner review, treating forced exit and strict internal probing as intentional availability behavior while keeping public /healthz compatibility.

options.title: Keep Timeout Internal
options.body: Remove the env override before merge if maintainers do not want a new operator contract for this watchdog timeout.

options.title: Require Deployed Restart Proof
options.body: Pause merge until a branch-deployed supervised Gateway shutdown/restart run proves the full recovery loop on a real host.

recommendation.title: Accept Recovery Contract
recommendation.body: Proceed after Gateway-owner review, treating forced exit and strict internal probing as intentional availability behavior while keeping public /healthz compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent supervised Gateway lock and PID-protection history makes this the closest available owner for the recovery-contract decision.
